summary: Frontend-only testing of /east-west.html Typical Apartments EAST/WEST tabs and expand-button bug fix. 8 of 9 requirements pass. Expand button fullscreen bug fix VERIFIED WORKING. One regression found: real mouse click on floor-plan image no longer opens the lightbox (pointer capture on .ew-plans-image retargets click event away from #ewPlansImg).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the floor-plan image (#ewPlansImg) — outside the expand button — no longer opens the lightbox with a real mouse click. Requirement 'Kat plani gorseline (expand disinda) tiklama da lightbox'i acar (mevcut davranis korunmali)' is broken. Regression caused by planViewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) in the pointerdown handler: pointer capture retargets the synthesized click event to .ew-plans-image, so #ewPlansImg's click listener never fires. JS-dispatched .click() works (proves the listener is wired), but a real user mouse click does not.

action_items: Fix image-click-to-open-lightbox regression in /app/frontend/js/east-west.js. Suggested fixes (pick one): (a) Attach openPlanLightbox to planViewport instead of imgEl and gate with `if (dragged) return;` — planViewport is the pointer-capture target so it will receive the click; (b) Move setPointerCapture out of pointerdown and only call it after pointermove detects >8px movement (i.e., true drag); (c) Call planViewport.releasePointerCapture(pid) inside pointerup BEFORE the click is dispatched. Verify by real mouse click on #ewPlansImg opens #ewPlansLightbox (adds .open class).
critical_code_review_comments: east-west.js swipe handler: setPointerCapture is called unconditionally on pointerdown, which changes the click event target and breaks child click handlers (imgEl). Prefer capturing only after movement threshold is crossed, or release capture before click dispatch.

PLANS_BY_TOWER.WEST is currently a shallow copy of EAST (WEST_PLANS = EAST_PLANS.map(...)). This is intentional per user note (WEST assets pending) but should be flagged in code with a TODO — currently only a comment above it.
expand button fix using `e.target.closest('.ew-plans-expand')` in pointerdown is correct and works as verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: 2 tower tabs + 4 plan tabs render; EAST + 3+1 active initially; WEST tab click activates WEST and deactivates EAST; 4+1 tab click switches title/image; expand button click opens lightbox (.open added) — BUG FIX CONFIRMED; lightbox close button works; horizontal drag >100px advances plan (planIdx+1) and does NOT open lightbox (didDrag guard works). FAILED: real mouse click on the floor-plan image (not on expand) fails to open lightbox because pointer capture on .ew-plans-image retargets the click. Preview URL: https://darg-clone-1.preview.emergentagent.com/east-west.html
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/js/east-west.js pointerdown handler on planViewport (.ew-plans-image), planViewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) is called for every pointerdown that doesn't originate on .ew-plans-expand. Per Pointer Events spec, when an element has pointer capture, the click event synthesized from that pointer is dispatched to the capturing element (or its ancestor), not to whatever child is under the cursor. Consequently, imgEl.addEventListener('click', openPlanLightbox) never fires from a real mouse click; only programmatic imgEl.click() works because it bypasses the pointer-capture retargeting. Reproduction: open east-west.html on desktop, click anywhere on the floor plan image (not the expand button) — nothing happens. Mitigation options listed in action_items.
